candidate_relations.reason: The clinical record describes a rare, hypertrophic, exophytic variant of HSV infection (herpes vegetans) confirmed by histology and IHC. 'Herpes simplex virus infection of the perianal skin' is the broader parent category and is compatible but lacks the required subtype specificity; it does not capture the vegetans morphology that constitutes the benchmark diagnosis.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Names the causative virus and anatomical site but omits the defining 'vegetans' (verrucous/exophytic) subtype designation that distinguishes herpes vegetans from ordinary HSV infection

case_quality_flags: Herpes vegetans is a rare diagnosis; the clinical record provides strong supporting evidence (verrucous exophytic morphology, HSV2 positivity on culture and IHC, multinucleated keratinocytes with gray-blue cytoplasm, immunocompromised background with CKD).
